content.text: In Nigeria, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-12|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]|Digital Product]] creators face a critical infrastructure gap: Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, yet their audiences demand instant product delivery. Conventional platforms reject their payment methods, leaving creators unable to automate sales. Google Apps Script, paired with crypto payment processors like NOWPayments, solves this by enabling [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-14|sovereign]] order fulfillment. This breakdown explains how to build a system that processes orders in under 30 seconds, without depending on third-party platforms. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

Google Apps Script is a cloud-based JavaScript platform that integrates directly with Google Workspace tools like Sheets and Drive. For digital commerce, it acts as the backend logic engine, processing orders, verifying payments, and triggering product delivery. When paired with NOWPayments’ crypto payment gateway, it eliminates the need for Stripe or PayPal. The system operates on infrastructure the creator owns: GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive for file delivery. This architecture ensures that no single platform can disrupt operations—a critical feature in regions where financial services are restricted.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The workflow begins when a buyer sends crypto to a payment address generated by NOWPayments. The platform’s webhook instantly notifies Google Apps Script once the transaction confirms on-chain. The script verifies the payment, logs the order in a Google Sheet, and generates a unique download link from Google Drive. This link is emailed to the buyer using Gmail’s API. The entire process, from payment confirmation to email delivery, completes in under 30 seconds. Cloudflare Workers can replace Apps Script for higher-volume stores, handling up to 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. It serves those selling ebooks, courses, templates, and software who need automatic delivery without platform dependencies. By owning the infrastructure, creators avoid fees, account freezes, and geographic restrictions. The stack is particularly suited for markets like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela, where crypto adoption outpaces traditional banking but digital commerce tools remain inaccessible.
Crypto payments eliminate chargebacks, but verify amounts before delivering products.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components include NOWPayments for crypto processing (0.5% fee, no KYC), Google Apps Script for backend logic, Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive for file hosting, and Gmail for delivery emails. For higher scalability, Cloudflare Workers and Supabase replace Apps Script and Sheets, respectively. Each component is open and interoperable: creators own the code, data, and deployment. This modularity ensures the system can adapt to new tools or requirements without vendor lock-in.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by setting up a NOWPayments account and configuring a webhook to trigger Google Apps Script. Write the script to verify payments, log orders, and generate download links. Host your storefront on GitHub Pages and connect it to the backend. Test the pipeline end-to-end with a small transaction. For a fully configured solution, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC email setup and five pre-loaded products. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to begin.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery with crypto payments works by using a webhook to trigger backend logic the moment a transaction confirms on-chain. NOWPayments sends a webhook notification to Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, which verifies the payment, logs the order, and generates a download link. This link is emailed to the buyer automatically. The process requires no manual intervention and completes in under 30 seconds, ensuring instant fulfillment regardless of payment network.
Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 webhook events per day on the free tier.

It includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration and end-to-end testing for five products. This stack is ideal for scaling beyond Google’s free tier limits. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to deploy.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a NOWPayments account and generate API keys. 2. Set up a Google Sheet to log orders and a Google Drive folder to host products. 3. Write a Google Apps Script to handle webhook events from NOWPayments. 4. Configure the script to verify payments, update the Sheet, and email download links via Gmail. 5. Deploy your storefront on GitHub Pages and connect it to the backend. 6. Test the pipeline with a small crypto transaction to ensure all components function.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I sell both digital and physical products?

Yes, but digital products are automatically delivered, while physical products require manual fulfillment. The system logs all orders in a Google Sheet or Supabase, allowing you to track and manage both types from a single dashboard.
What happens if a payment fails or the buyer sends the wrong amount?

The script verifies payment amounts before triggering delivery. If the amount is incorrect or the payment fails, the system does not generate a download link. You can manually refund or adjust the order via the order log.
How do I handle chargebacks or disputes with crypto payments?

Crypto transactions are irreversible, so chargebacks are not possible. However, you can issue refunds manually by sending crypto back to the buyer’s wallet address. The order log helps track such cases.
Can I integrate this with my existing website or email provider?
Yes, the backend logic can be adapted to work with any frontend or email service. For example, Cloudflare Workers can replace Google Apps Script, and Resend can replace Gmail for email delivery.
What if I need to scale beyond Google’s free tier limits?

Migrate to the Edge Commerce Stack, which uses Cloudflare Workers and Supabase for higher scalability. This stack handles up to 100,000 webhook events per day and stores unlimited orders in a serverless database.
Own the infrastructure: no platform can disrupt your operations.
